menu.label: What We Make
menu.title: Our Menu
menu.description: Everything is prepared fresh daily using traditional Gujarati recipes. Order by WhatsApp for same-day delivery.
menu.partyDescription: For groups of 5 or more — every dish below is priced per person, with a minimum of 5 servings per dish. Perfect for gatherings, pujas, birthdays & get-togethers.
menu.partyAdvance: Party orders need to be placed at least 1 day in advance of your event.

1.name: Ahmedabad Khaman
1.description: Soft, spongy steamed gram flour cake — Ahmedabad's most beloved snack. Served with fresh coriander chutney.

2.name: Ahmedabad Dhokla
2.description: Fluffy fermented dhokla tempered with mustard seeds, green chilli & curry leaves. A Gujarati classic.

3.name: Tam Tam Khaman
3.description: A spicier, crispy-edged khaman with a signature tangy tempering. A real crowd favourite.

4.name: Idada
4.description: White rice & urad dal steamed cake, light and delicate. A traditional breakfast favourite from Surat.

5.name: Mumbai Vada Pav
5.description: The legendary Mumbai street burger — crispy potato vada in a soft pav with chutneys. Pure street magic.

6.name: Kutchi Dabeli
6.description: Sweet & spicy Kutch-style sandwich stuffed with masala potato, pomegranate seeds & roasted peanuts.

7.name: Spicy Samosa
7.description: Golden crispy pastry filled with peppery potato & peas. Made fresh, not frozen. Served with chutneys.

8.name: Batata Vada
8.description: Classic besan-battered potato fritters, spiced to perfection. Great on their own or with green chutney.

9.name: Bhavnagari Mirchi
9.description: Bhavnagar's iconic stuffed green chilli fritters — bold, addictive, and not for the faint-hearted! 🔥

10.name: Gulab Jamun
10.description: Soft milk solids dumplings soaked in rose-cardamom sugar syrup. A heavenly Gujarati mithai.

11.name: Shrikhand
11.description: Creamy strained yogurt sweetened with sugar & saffron. Made fresh with full-fat dahi.

12.name: Mango Shrikhand
12.description: Shrikhand blended with Alphonso mango pulp — an irresistible summer special worth every euro.

13.name: Surti Undhiyu
13.description: The king of Gujarati winter dishes — slow-cooked seasonal vegetables with fenugreek muthiya. A labour of love.

14.name: Handvo
14.description: Savoury Gujarati lentil cake baked with vegetables & sesame seeds. Crispy outside, soft inside.

15.name: Masala Chaas
15.description: Chilled buttermilk tempered with cumin, black salt, ginger & fresh coriander. The perfect digestif.

16.name: Pani Poori
16.description: Crispy hollow puris filled with tangy tamarind water, spiced potato & chickpeas. The ultimate Gujarati street snack!

17.name: Thepla+Mixed Pickle
17.description: Soft, golden Gujarati flatbreads made with fresh fenugreek leaves — fragrant, lightly spiced, and pan-roasted to perfection. Served with a tangy Mixed Pickle that brings it all together.

18.name: Batata Poha
18.description: Fluffy flattened rice tossed with turmeric, mustard seeds, peanuts & fresh coriander. A light, comforting Gujarati breakfast classic for the whole group.

19.name: Pav Bhaji
19.description: Buttery mashed vegetable bhaji simmered in signature masala, served with toasted pav, onions & lemon. The ultimate crowd-pleaser.

20.name: Sev Tameta
20.description: Tangy Kathiyawadi tomato curry topped generously with crispy sev. Sweet, spicy & utterly addictive with rotli or rice.

21.name: Lasaniya Bataka
21.description: Fiery Kathiyawadi baby potatoes slow-cooked in a bold garlic-red chilli masala. For those who love it hot! 🔥

22.name: Gujarati Dal
22.description: The iconic sweet-tangy-spicy toor dal with peanuts, kokum & jaggery. Tastes just like home — khatti mithi perfection.

23.name: Gujarati Kadhi
23.description: Silky yogurt-besan kadhi tempered with curry leaves, cloves & cinnamon. Light, soothing & the perfect partner to khichdi or rice.

24.name: Lasaniya Kaju
24.description: Rich cashews simmered in a bold Kathiyawadi garlic-chilli gravy — indulgent, fiery & unforgettable. Served with 3 roti or paratha per person.

25.name: Kaju Gathiya
25.description: A royal Kathiyawadi shaak of cashews & soft gathiya in a spiced yogurt-tomato gravy. Served with 3 roti or paratha per person.

26.name: Paneer Butter Masala
26.description: Soft paneer cubes in a silky, buttery tomato-cashew gravy — everyone's favourite, made the homely way. Served with 3 roti or paratha per person.

27.name: Gujarati Thali
27.description: A complete meal — the full Gujarati feast on one plate: 1 samosa, paneer sabzi, dal, steamed rice, sweet of the day, salad, raita, achar & a glass of masala chaas. Choose your roti/paratha & Khaman/Dhokla below.

28.name: Sukhi Bhaji
28.description: Dry-spiced baby potatoes tempered with cumin & sesame, finished with pomegranate, roasted peanuts & fresh coriander. A festive Gujarati classic.

story.portrait: A husband & wife,<break/>cooking with heart<break/>in the heart of Paris.
story.label: Behind the Kitchen
story.title: A family,<break/>a tradition,<break/>a promise.
story.origin: We are a husband and wife duo, originally from Gujarat, India, now bringing the authentic flavours of our homeland to the streets of Paris.
story.experience: With over 9 years of professional culinary experience as a Chef in Paris, every dish carries the precision of a trained kitchen and the warmth of a home cook. Each item is prepared fresh daily using recipes passed down through generations.
story.delivery: We deliver personally — together — because we want every order to feel like it came from family.

chef.title: 9+ Years as a Chef
chef.description: Professional culinary experience in Paris — trained hands, authentic recipes, restaurant-quality taste at your doorstep.

vegetarian.title: 100% Vegetarian
vegetarian.description: Every dish is fully vegetarian — made with love and no compromise.

delivery.title: Personal Delivery
delivery.description: We deliver it ourselves — no middlemen, no delays, no surprises.

contact.title: Always Reachable
contact.description: Call or WhatsApp us on <phoneOne>{{phone1}}</phoneOne> or <phoneTwo>{{phone2}}</phoneTwo> for orders & queries.

packaging.label: Reliable · Hygienic · Safe
packaging.title: Packed with Care
packaging.description: We take our packaging as seriously as the cooking itself.

sealing.title: Spill-Proof Sealing
sealing.description: Every container is sealed air-tight so your food arrives exactly as it left our kitchen — no leaks, no mess, guaranteed.

temperature.title: Temperature Retained
temperature.description: Insulated packing keeps your tiffin warm during transit. Your dal will still be piping hot when you open it.

materials.title: Eco-Friendly Materials
materials.description: We use food-grade, eco-conscious containers — because we care about your family and the environment equally.
